chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Chapter 584: The Ninefold Chaos Seal – Ji Ning Refines a Supreme Treasure
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning refines an Innate Supreme-grade Spirit-Treasure bearing the legendary Ninefold Chaos Seal, gaining profound Dao insights and shocking ancient artifact spirits with his Heaven-defying soul power.
og_title: Ji Ning’s New Treasure Humbles an Ancient Artifact Spirit
og_description: An Innate Supreme-grade Spirit-Treasure with a Chaos Seal so deep even Lady Nuwa couldn’t fully master it. Ji Ning refines the first level and achieves a Daofather-level feat on the spot.
twitter_title: Can You Fully Refine a Chaos Seal? Even Nuwa Didn’t Make It
twitter_description: Ji Ning gets a set of 3,600 Star-Gold Beads with the Ninefold Chaos Seal—a seal from the chaos itself. His Heartforce lets him achieve what even Daoist Three Purities’ disciples couldn’t.

lore_anchors.definition: A natural, infinitely profound seal that manifests within the primordial chaos, described as patternless and endless like the mathematical constant pi. Only a select few have ever refined even a fraction of its power.
The supreme leader of the Daoist path in the Three Realms, who discovered the Chaos Seal in the chaos and fused it onto the Star-Gold Beads, but only managed to refine the seventh level himself.
A creator goddess of Chinese myth; in Desolate Era, she reached the level of Pangu during the war of annihilation. She studied the Chaos Seal for three years and refined the eighth level.
Also known as the Immortal-Slaying Sword Formation; the most famous killing formation of the Primordial Era, which was modeled on the Ninefold Chaos Seal.
The final fusion stage of the Star-Gold Beads, where 3,600 beads merge into 36. A feat only Daofathers can achieve; no Heavenly God or True Immortal has ever succeeded.

Three thousand six hundred innate spirit-treasures formed from the crystal nuclei of fallen stars, nurtured in Pangu's World, and later inscribed with the Ninefold Chaos Seal by Daoist Three Purities.
